content.title: About
content.content: Cappuccino is an espresso topped with a thick layer of milk foam. In this version non‑dairy milk (soy, oat, almond, etc.) is used, making the drink suitable for those avoiding dairy. It offers a smooth, creamy taste with a subtle coffee bitterness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “cappuccino” comes from the Italian word for “little capuchin”, referring to the drink’s colour resembling the robes of Capuchin monks.
The first cappuccino was created in Italy in the early 20th century.
Plant‑based milks lower the saturated‑fat and lactose content compared with cow’s milk.
In many countries cappuccino is served with a sprinkle of cinnamon or cocoa powder.
Cappuccino often serves as a base for flavored versions such as vanilla, caramel, or mint.

items.title: Stimulating caffeine effect
items.content: The espresso provides caffeine, which can improve alertness and concentration.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Non‑dairy milks usually contain less saturated fat than dairy milk, supporting heart health.

items.title: Source of antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals from plant milk
items.content: Soy and oat milks are often fortified with calcium, vitamin D and vitamin B12.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Some plant milks contain probiotics that promote a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: High caffeine intake may cause anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Some individuals are allergic to soy, oat, or almond milk.

items.title: Added sugar in flavored versions
items.content: Pre‑flavored cappuccinos often contain added sugars, increasing calorie count.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain drugs, such as CNS stimulants.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cappuccino is served hot in ceramic cups, often garnished with cinnamon, cocoa powder, or chocolate shavings. Sweeteners can be added to taste. Choose a plant‑based milk without animal‑derived additives for a vegan option.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Prepared cappuccino is best enjoyed immediately. If you need to store it, keep it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for no more than 24 hours; re‑heat and re‑foam before serving.
